svg.text: C. The close: a loop around the block party
Larch Street ends in a turning circle: the party is the watched hub, the Back Way loops behind every house. 100 x 100 m.
the stem: out to the bus stop
THE BACK WAY: 4 m ring alley, garage backs 2.7 / outer wall 3.2
hill house gate (chained), +6 above the ring
grid 10 m; heights in metres above the street
Roof route (gold: fast, unseen on back pitches)
Under route (creek bed, culvert, crawl spaces)
Fence or wall 1.8 m: mantle from the ground
Hedge 1.2 m: hides a crouched Nadia
Switch: open or shut per night
A loop instead of a line: Theo and the
watchers circle; you circle the other way
The party island sees the whole ring road
(a panopticon): the street layer is the
most watched of all three proposals.
Costs: the story's linear street and the
120 m escape move to the stem; less like
Section from the island to the outer wall (north), looking west
heights drawn 2.6x taller than lengths so they read; numbers are true metres
